scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE, separate accounts: five small figures standing in a vertical column; EVERY one of the five, including the building, has its own separate open ledger book beside it, with a clear gap between each figure so no book touches another. Top to bottom: a figure in a suit with a briefcase labelled INVESTORS; a small office building with a blank facade and no sign, labelled COMPANY; a figure with a shopping bag labelled CUSTOMERS; a figure with a hard hat and laptop labelled EMPLOYEES; a figure with a plain unmarked delivery crate labelled SUPPLIERS. Thin vertical navy dividers between the ledgers show they are never added together.

MIDDLE ZONE, one Rotaline decision: at the left a group of thirty tiny customer figures on a narrow old footpath beside one specialist holding a wrench, labelled once 30 ON THE OLD PATH. Two routes lead right from that group. The upper route is a short, straight road in the upper half of the zone ending abruptly at a cliff edge with a barrier; it is crossed out with a thin navy line, labelled CUT-OFF AT MONTH 7, and carries an ochre rubber stamp labelled BREACH. The lower route is a separate, longer teal road that runs along the bottom of the zone and never meets or touches the upper road or the cliff; it ends at the right in a new, modern building with an open door, and the customer figures walk along it toward that building; at its start stands a gate with a checklist, labelled TESTS AT MONTH 6, and the road itself is labelled MIGRATE MONTHS 7–12. A small calendar page with a magnifying glass sits halfway along the lower road, labelled REVIEW AT MONTH 9.

RIGHT ZONE, two kinds of money: at the top, a stack of plain blank coins with no symbols on them, labelled €150K CASH beside an hourglass labelled €70K FREED TIME, with a thin navy line between them showing they are different things. Below them, one downward arrow to a single person at a small desk with a data folder, working half the day, drawn with a half-filled clock face, labelled HALF-TIME SERVICE €75K.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: INVESTORS, COMPANY, CUSTOMERS, EMPLOYEES, SUPPLIERS, 30 ON THE OLD PATH, CUT-OFF AT MONTH 7, BREACH, TESTS AT MONTH 6, MIGRATE MONTHS 7–12, REVIEW AT MONTH 9, €150K CASH, €70K FREED TIME, HALF-TIME SERVICE €75K. No words, signs or numbers on the building, crate, ledgers, checklist, calendar, folder or clock; do not write OFFICE; no currency symbols on the coins. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Investors, the company, customers, employees and suppliers each hold a separate ledger; thirty Rotaline customers on an old path face a crossed-out cut-off at month seven stamped as a breach and a chosen migration in months seven to twelve behind month-six tests, with a review at month nine; €150,000 of cash is set apart from €70,000 of freed time, leading to a €75,000 half-time service.
caption: Each group keeps its own account; Rotaline refuses a cut-off that breaks contracts, migrates behind tests, and keeps saved cash apart from freed time.
